values.title: Post-seal nonstandard-spacetime realization boundary
values.statement: The sealed wormhole, warp and closed-timelike results are admissibility theorems. The complete registered authority vector contains no confirmed physical realization of any of the three, and current catalog tests report no nonstandard strong-field signal in their stated analyses.
values.generation_rule: Generate the complete eight-axis post-seal nonstandard-spacetime status product.
values.grammar_boundary: Every formal admissibility result, registered authority search row, non-detection scope and explicit no-realization statement.
values.exact_result: Wormhole, warp and exact closed-timelike admissibility boundaries are formally sealed; no authoritative realization appears in the registered source vector, so all remain unconfirmed physical frontier predictions.
values.induction_base: Each formal admissibility theorem retains its complete source/causal ledger.
values.induction_step: Any future claimed realization must append a separately committed controlled measurement and cannot rewrite the admissibility receipt.
exclusions: no inference from formal admissibility to existence
no unlimited no-go conclusion from a finite source search
no deletion of the standing prediction
target_rows: complete registered NIST/CNES/LIGO-GWOSC/EHT vector with unfavorable controls
values.falsification_condition: A controlled authoritative experiment realizes one of the structures but violates its sealed positive-source, causal or complete-return ledger, or the validation promotes formal admissibility to observed existence without evidence.
